items.title: A morphism from an affine space over the base to a space with affine diagonal is affine

items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma with its four assertions about affineness of a morphism g : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over B: if X is affine over B and the diagonal of Y over B is affine (or Y is separated over B) then g is affine, and the same for a morphism from an affine scheme to an algebraic space with affine diagonal (source lines 4115-4130). The proof of (1) is a chain inside the span: the base change X x_B Y -> Y is affine, the graph (1, g) is the base change of the diagonal of Y, hence affine, and a composite of affine morphisms is affine; parts (2), (3) and (4) are then obtained from (1) and (2) using that a closed immersion is affine and that separatedness of Y over B says the diagonal is a closed immersion.
